276756658.description:
Collector's Assorted Mineral Gemstone Specimens Box 14in Botswana Agate
This collection features a variety of mineral and gemstone specimens housed in a clear plastic compartmentalized storage box measuring approximately 14 inches wide. The assortment includes labeled and bagged stones such as Botswana agate, tourmaline, amethyst, sunstone, snakeskin agate, psilomelane, hematite, turquoise, barite rose, fire opal, and multiple polished and raw stones with diverse colors and patterns. Specimens are both tumbled and rough, with some stones accompanied by origin and identification cards. The stones are in very good condition with minimal visible wear. The storage box is used but remains intact.

Bulk 12.4 Natural Mineral Rock Specimens Lot Quartz Pyrite Geodes Rough Stones
Assorted natural mineral and rock specimens totaling approximately 12.4 pounds. Includes multiple open and unbroken geodes, rough pyrite, quartz, rose quartz, slate, and various tumbled and raw stones. Features a variety of colors such as clear, white, metallic gold, pink, blue, green, and black. Many pieces display natural crystal structures and textures. Some specimens are bagged or boxed for organization. All items are in raw, unprocessed condition. Presented in a plastic storage bin. No brand or manufacturer indicated. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or display.

277188477.description:
Large Assorted Rocks Minerals Gemstones Fossils Lot with Amethyst Geodes
This large assorted lot includes a variety of rocks, minerals, gemstones, and fossil specimens suitable for collectors or educational use. The collection features rough and polished stones, amethyst crystal clusters, geodes, mineral samples, and carved gemstone figurines including a dolphin, whale, turtle, and small fish. Several display containers hold smaller polished stones and a labeled educational set is included. Also provided is a 'Rocks and Minerals: A Study Guide' booklet from Scott Resources, Inc. Specimens are stored in clear boxes, jars, and a teal storage bin. Condition is good used. The lot contains both natural and polished pieces, plus a keychain with fossilized shark teeth.
